name: interlock ransomware group
iocPatterns: Spear-phishing emails related to patch management
Network activity from known C2 domains
Presence of Mimikatz in Event Viewer logs
recommendedActions: Implement proactive patch management and MFA for critical systems
Deploy SIEM for threat detection and response
Segment sensitive networks to limit lateral movement
campaignsText: Interlock operates with rapid campaign deployment, targeting multiple sectors and regions. Notable operations include early 2026 attacks using Cisco vulnerabilities and subsequent campaigns leveraging DarkSword and Coruna exploit kits.
description: The Interlock Ransomware Group emerged in March 2026, exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities and deploying sophisticated ransomware campaigns targeting critical sectors globally. Their primary goal is financial gain through disrupting businesses and extorting ransoms.
goals: The group targets critical infrastructure and enterprise networks across various sectors to achieve financial gains via ransomware extortion. Their victims include high-profile organizations in the US, EU, Japan, and India, focusing on disrupting business continuity.
